title: Holiday registrations
description: Your registrations for holiday care and their status.

statusNote.received: The provider is checking your registration and will write to you.
statusNote.confirmed: The provider has confirmed your registration.
statusNote.cancelled: This registration no longer applies. If you have questions, contact the provider.

documentsHint: You will find the confirmation and the invoice under Documents.
emptyDescription: Register your child with the email address of this account. Then the registration appears here.

card.title: Your holiday registrations
card.more: {count, plural, one {# more registration} other {# more registrations}}
card.showAllTooltip: Opens the list of all holiday registrations of your children.

toDocumentsTooltip: Opens your documents with the confirmation and invoice.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Voluntary. You can withdraw or give each consent again at any time. The OGS caring for your child in the holidays sees the change at once.

dates.notGiven: You did not give it when you registered.

consents.withdrawTooltip: Withdraws the consent. moto asks you first.
consents.grantTooltip: Gives the consent. moto asks you first.
consents.withdrawNote: The withdrawal applies from now on. The OGS caring for your child in the holidays sees it at once.
consents.grantNote: The consent applies from now on. You can withdraw it again at any time.
consents.savedButStale: Your change is saved. Only the display is not up to date yet.
